aboutme.title: About me
myinfo: I am 28 years old and work full-time as a Senior Consultant IT-Security at usd AG,
after successfully completing my master's degree in IT-Security at the Technical University Darmstadt.
As a penetration tester at usd AG
I analyse web applications, systems, mobile applications, and SAP environments for vulnerabilities,
lead medium-sized projects, and advise organisations from startups to large enterprises. Next to that,
I support in improving our technical service offerings and help lead our internal tool development, which lets me combine my two passions,
In my free time I also develop security related tools of my own, which keeps me exploring new

content: In 2017 I started my bachelors degree with great amount of fascination in software development

and Cybersecurity at the TU Darmstadt.

Since then I have gained many skills and much
knowledge in the various disciplines of computer science through my studies but also through
personal and university projects. Especially through those project, I have gained much knowledge

and a variety of programming languages and frameworks.

In my free time I also like to
indulge in solving tasks in CTFs or Hack-the-box und am continuously keeping me up to date.

workingstudent.title: usd AG - HeroLab (Working student)
workingstudent.description: At usd AG I worked as a student in the Penetration Testing department. My main responsibility was to develop and maintain internal tools that support penetration testers during their work. Through this work and the company's efforts to integrate working students more into consultation projects, I gained an insight into the penetration testing process as well as into other facets of real-world IT security.

fulltime.title: usd AG - HeroLab (Senior Consultant IT Security)
fulltime.description: As a penetration tester and technical IT security consultant, I analyze a wide range of customer assets for vulnerabilities, from web applications and systems to mobile applications and SAP systems. Leading medium-sized projects, I advise organizations from startups to large enterprises. Through numerous penetration tests, I have built extensive experience in both technical analysis and client consulting. I also contribute to advancing our service offerings and help lead internal tool development to continuously improve the efficiency and quality of our work.
